A1_power.question: How many target lines does a future frozen 2x2 (static vs reproducibility-aware predictor x simple vs proposed adaptive scheduler) need for its primary contrast, given realistic between-line variance of the paired difference?
inputs: ../feedback_validation_20261003/results/jaaks_primary/lines.jsonl: per (line, replicate) arm totals 'validated', 'screen_hits' at the primary 20% budget (derived, exposed)

../feedback_validation_20261003/results/followup_verification.json: contrast mean_diff and bootstrap intervals (derived, exposed); per-line verify-hits values are not stored there, so their SD is back-calculated from the interval half-width x sqrt(125)/1.96 and labelled as an approximation
A1_power.estimand: per-line mean paired difference D = Y_proposed - Y_baseline in independently confirmed discoveries per line (line = unit; SV and VS replicates averaged per line where both exist), and ratio-of-sums gain G = sum Y_proposed / sum Y_baseline - 1
quantities: mean and SD of per-line validated discoveries for history_mean (the static* arm) and other static arms

SD of per-line paired differences between arms whose purchase sets differ (feedback - history_mean, history_rate - history_mean, ridge_static - history_mean, gbm_static - history_mean, random - history_mean)
correlation between SV and VS replicate values within a line (how much a single-replicate design inflates variance)

required lines n for (i) superiority (lower bound > 0) and (ii) threshold claim (lower bound > tau) at alpha 0.05 two-sided-equivalent one-sided 0.025 and power 0.8 / 0.9, for tau in {0.05, 0.10} relative and assumed true gains in {tau, 1.5 tau, 2 tau}; and the n at which an upper bound below tau (futility) is reachable when the true gain is 0
design effect from pairs recurring across lines: compare line-bootstrap SE with a two-way (line x pair) bootstrap SE, using the earlier study's S13 interval width ratio
A1_power.method: normal approximation for n = ((z_a + z_b) * SD_D / (delta_abs))^2 with delta_abs = G * baseline mean; checked by a stratified line bootstrap of the observed per-line data (10,000 resamples, seed 20261004) and by resampling-based power for selected n (2,000 simulated studies, lines resampled with replacement and a constant per-line shift added to generate the alternative); no new outcome of any release is read
A1_power.units: cell line (stratified by tissue); pairs recur across lines (design effect reported); SV/VS are two plate-disjoint role assignments of the same line, not independent units
A1_power.stopping: single pass; the numbers are reported as computed; if lines.jsonl lacks a needed field, record it as unavailable rather than reconstructing it from the raw release
